title: Exhibition Textile Conservator
text: The Fictional Lindenlight Costume Museum in Leipzig seeks an Exhibition Textile Conservator. Plan documented stabilisation treatments, build reversible display supports and brief gallery colleagues on safe handling. Relevant conservation training and practical collaboration with curators are required. Experience interpreting historic construction is useful. Explain the boundaries of your authority; independent chemical analysis is not required. Submit an English CV and a Germany-market cover letter. Supply measured outcomes only where evidence exists.
